## What it will cover

::: {.mm-stub-outline}
- Protein structure files (PDB/mmCIF), chains, ligands and waters
- Finding and describing a binding site
- Preparing receptor and ligand; docking with AutoDock Vina
- Reading docking scores and poses critically
- ML rescoring and pose classification
- Lab 8: dock a small library into a kinase and rescore the poses
:::

## Planned learning outcomes

1. Prepare a protein and a ligand and run a docking calculation reproducibly.
2. Interpret docking poses and scores, including their well-known failure modes.
3. Train a simple rescoring model and evaluate it without leakage across protein families.

## In the meantime

Everything here builds on Part I, in particular the evaluation habits of [Chapter 2](../../part-1-foundations/ch02-ml-fundamentals/index.html). Episode [2.6](../../part-1-foundations/ch02-ml-fundamentals/06-pipelines-leakage.html) already introduces the group splits that become scaffold splits here.
